scene_type: 2D (near-nadir top-down view of a street; motion in the ground plane)
units: pixels and seconds; image x to the right, y downward; no metric scale assumed

camera.evidence: phase correlation of static lower-left region vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.01 px for all frames (scripts/finalize.py)
camera.view: top-down over a straight street running horizontally across the image; ground plane ~ parallel to image plane, so one px-scale applies to all ground-level objects. Tall objects (buildings, utility box) show slight perspective lean (their sides are visible).

lighting: low sun: every moving object casts a long shadow toward the upper-left (direction ~(-1,-0.35) in image). Shadows are NOT part of object extents.

cyclist.description: person in black riding a white/silver bicycle with a rear rack, on the road (asphalt), moving right-to-left along y~465-478
cyclist.distinguish: the only object on the road; dark rider, white bike frame, ladder-like rear rack at right end
cyclist.visible_frames: front wheel tip emerges from under the right tree canopy at ~frame 6; partially hidden under canopy frames 6-14 (occluded=1 in track); fully visible frames 15-98 (still in view at the end, ref x ~356 at frame 98)
cyclist.reference_point: ref_x/ref_y = centre of the bike+rider bounding box (midpoint between front-wheel tip and rear-rack end; handlebar mid-height). extra_x/extra_y = rough rider pelvis/saddle estimate (16.5 px behind ref, toward rear). Rig root unknown; for displacements/speeds the choice does not matter (rigid translation).
cyclist.motion_summary_px: almost perfectly uniform: linear fit frames 14-98 x = 1619.23 - 12.849*frame, y = 479.71 - 0.154*frame (template centre); rms residual 0.26 px (x), 0.07 px (y). Per-frame displacement 12.85 px/frame (= 424 px/s), heading ~0.7 deg upward from -x direction.

size_px.length_note: front wheel tip to rear end of rack, measured on frame 50 zoom (x 907..1040); mask PCA length frames 40-70 median ~125 (thin front tip lost in mask)
size_px.width_note: handlebar span / rider shoulders, y 448..494 at frame 50; mask height median 44

pedestrian.description: person in white shirt and dark trousers walking on the upper (far-side) sidewalk, right-to-left along y~317-320, between the building steps and the road curb
pedestrian.distinguish: the only person on the sidewalk; white top seen from above, dark head
pedestrian.reference_point: ref_x/ref_y = head / torso centre seen from above (proxy for the pelvis in a top-down view), = template centre + (6,-1)
pedestrian.motion_summary_px: walks steadily left: ref x 1410.5 (f0) -> 1083.9 (f98); mean per-frame step 3.35 px/frame (~110.5 px/s), per-frame steps 2.6-4.0 px oscillating with the gait (speed peaks near frames 2, 20, 37, 55, 71, 88 -> one step ~17 frames ~0.52 s). Path length f0-98 = 328.3 px, net displacement 326.7 px. y nearly constant (316-321).

size_px.length_along_motion: torso/head ~27-35; including swinging legs/arms up to ~55-65 (varies with gait; mask often loses dark legs on shadowed ground)
size_px.height: not observable (top-down view; standing height cannot be measured from this view)

utility_box.description: light grey/white cabinet (kiosk/utility box) on upper sidewalk near the curb, left part of image

manhole_cover.description: round manhole on the road, left part of image, bright ring around dark disc
manhole_cover.note: outer ring radius 39-48 px by radial profile; +-3 px

right_tree.description: tree on the road edge at right; canopy hides the cyclist at the start

left_tree.description: tree lower-middle, over lower sidewalk/road edge

parked_bicycle.description: pink/rose bicycle with brown basket leaning diagonally at lower sidewalk next to a planter, does not move

small_round_object.description: small dark/green round item on upper-left sidewalk (bollard top or dropped object), static

planters_bushes.description: flowering bushes: top right (x 1600-1800, y 105-245) and lower middle (x 975-1180, y 860-1050)

events.what: pedestrian already walking left (moving in every frame); cyclist hidden under right tree canopy (only its shadow visible)
cyclist front wheel tip first visible at canopy edge (x~1450)
cyclist fully out from under the canopy (rear rack end x < 1488); tracked by template from frame 14
cyclist passes the pedestrian (same x), closest approach 155.9 px (they are on road vs sidewalk, never in contact)
end of clip: both still moving left at the same pace; no stops, starts, turns, contacts or collisions occur

relations: cyclist and pedestrian move in the same direction (left) on parallel lines; ref-point y separation 158.5 px (f6) slowly shrinking to 147 px (f98). Cyclist ref x passes the pedestrian ref x at frame 22 (t=0.667 s), when their ref-ref distance is minimal (155.9 px).
